svg.title: The reward: utilisation minus a traffic penalty
svg.desc: The reward is r = U minus lambda times T over M. U, the cycle-weighted mean PE utilisation, is the reward; lambda T over M penalises SRAM-DRAM traffic per multiply-accumulate. U is the sum over stages of cycles times utilisation, divided by the sum of cycles.

g.text: Equation 1 · the reward a search is trained on
Equation 2 · utilisation, weighted by how long each stage runs

text.tspan: A stage that runs longer counts for more, so a mapping cannot look good
by being fast on a stage that barely matters.

g.text: cycles the simulator reports for stage s

svg.text: Source: common/optimizers/environment.py — reward as implemented; λ = 0.01 (schematic typesetting)
